boundaries.command_authority: Commander issues enterprise directives and receives escalation evidence
boundaries.constitutional_authority: enterprise governance, command directives, escalation, emergency response, recovery, and shutdown authority
boundaries.dependency_direction: Position Registry -> Commander for escalation/governance; Commander -> Position Registry for governed status evidence
boundaries.escalation_authority: Commander is terminal enterprise escalation recipient for governance emergencies
boundaries.evidence_obligation: directive, acknowledgement, escalation, emergency, recovery, and shutdown evidence
boundaries.interface_authority: Commander produces directives; Position Registry acknowledges disposition and evidence
boundaries.mutation_authority: Commander does not directly mutate Position Registry state; directives execute only through constitutional mechanisms
boundaries.ownership_boundary: Commander owns governance directives; Position Registry owns canonical position truth

boundaries.archival_authority: Historian archives immutable records and preserves retrieval lineage
boundaries.constitutional_authority: historical custody, archival preservation, replay support, correction lineage, supersession lineage, and restoration evidence
boundaries.correction_lineage: historical corrections preserve predecessor, correction reason, authority, timestamp, and immutable lineage
boundaries.dependency_direction: Position Registry -> Historian for archival custody; Position Registry replay -> Historian evidence retrieval

determinations.authority_during_historical_correction: originating truth owner corrects domain truth; Historian preserves correction lineage and custody records
determinations.authority_during_restoration: Historian restores immutable evidence/custody records; Position Registry restores domain state through replay/recovery authority

boundaries.evidence_custody: Historian may custody immutable evidence without acquiring ownership or mutation authority
boundaries.evidence_obligation: historical custody receipt, archival manifest, correction lineage, supersession lineage, replay retrieval, and restoration evidence
boundaries.historical_custody: Historian may receive immutable custody of historical Position Registry records and evidence
boundaries.interface_authority: Position Registry produces historical/evidence custody packages; Historian acknowledges custody receipt
boundaries.mutation_authority: Historian does not mutate Position Registry truth or historical records; corrections are preserved through lineage records
boundaries.ownership_boundary: Historian holds historical custody; Position Registry retains domain truth ownership unless ownership is transferred by explicit doctrine
boundaries.reconciliation_authority: Position Registry reconciles canonical position truth; Historian reconciles custody completeness and lineage integrity
boundaries.replay_authority: replay may consume Historian evidence as immutable historical input; replay does not permit Historian mutation
boundaries.supersession_lineage: supersession preserves predecessor and successor references without destroying historical records

boundaries.constitutional_authority: runtime, persistence, configuration, availability, disaster recovery, deployment, and platform support
boundaries.dependency_direction: Position Registry -> Infrastructure for runtime, persistence, configuration, and recovery capability
boundaries.escalation_authority: Infrastructure receives runtime, persistence, and disaster-recovery escalations
boundaries.evidence_obligation: runtime availability, persistence, configuration, backup, restore, and failure evidence
boundaries.interface_authority: Infrastructure provides platform service interfaces and receives health/failure evidence
boundaries.mutation_authority: Infrastructure does not mutate Position Registry business state except through authorized enterprise mechanisms
boundaries.ownership_boundary: Infrastructure owns infrastructure capability, not Position Registry business truth

boundaries.constitutional_authority: enterprise observation, anomaly observation, evidence observation, notification, escalation, and finding generation
boundaries.dependency_direction: Sentinel -> Position Registry for observation access; Position Registry -> Sentinel for observation findings only where constitutionally required
boundaries.escalation_authority: Sentinel escalates anomalies through Commander-first/governed channels
boundaries.evidence_obligation: observation trace, anomaly finding, evidence observation, notification, and escalation evidence
boundaries.interface_authority: Sentinel produces observation findings and escalation notices
boundaries.mutation_authority: Sentinel has no mutation authority over Position Registry state
boundaries.observation_authority: Sentinel observes runtime, anomaly, event, evidence, reconciliation, replay, and recovery behavior
boundaries.ownership_boundary: Sentinel owns observation/findings evidence, never Position Registry state

conflicts.deterministic_disposition: Commander governs but does not own Position Registry state
Historian custodies immutable history without owning domain truth
observation never mutates Position Registry state

escalations.terminal_authority: Infrastructure with Commander escalation if governance-impacting
